explication: AIOX is a CLI-first AI orchestration framework and project installer. The principal workflow is: a developer invokes the CLI, selects installation and IDE options, AIOX configures the project and integrations, then specialized agents plan work and turn those plans into development stories and implementation results. Installation includes dependency and platform checks, environment setup, integrity validation, rollback, updates, and MCP support. Agent-to-artifact relationships are partly documented in the README; unsampled core agent implementations are therefore represented conservatively.
